segments.text: Motorway. In front of you, a car transporter. Seven red cars. Exactly like yours.
Then its ramp comes down. Right in front of your bumper. And the driver waves you on. What do you do?
Most drivers think: overtake! Full throttle, past the ramp!
But the transporter is faster. It swerves in front of you. And up you go, to the top deck.
Next stop: a car showroom. You're on a turntable. With a giant red bow. On sale, half price.
Here's how you do it properly.
Stay behind it. Window down. And show him your car is not new.
Old crisps. A sock from last week. And a sandwich from... nobody knows.
The smell reaches the driver. That is definitely not a new car. Ramp up. Very fast.
He feels a bit sorry for you. So he grabs something from the delivery.
New car smell. One spray, and your car sparkles, like on day one.
Next exam question: a combine harvester, as wide as the whole road. Follow, so you don't miss it.
